entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. C1/03/2023,
Trial No. 2009/2024 for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420, 341, 323, 379, 504, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, lodged by the complainant Ram Nagina Rai.
3. Pursuant to the last order by the coordinate Bench, the informant is present and they have jointly submitted that the matter be sent to the Mediation Centre.

4. Let the parties appear before the Mediation Centre on 15.05.2025 and a report shall be submitted before the Bench on 24.07.2025.
5.
The interim protection granted to the petitioner shall remain continue.

6. List this case on 24.07.2025.
(Rajiv Roy, J) vinayak/-
